title.zh: 结构工程学会发布既有结构安全评估方法，减少不必要的加固和拆除
title.en: IStructE publishes a method for assessing existing structures and avoiding unnecessary strengthening

summary.zh: 英国结构工程学会发布既有工程结构安全评估指南，提出从完善计算、结合更确定的荷载和材料证据、再判断超限严重程度的分步方法。它反映出行业正在从“按新建结构重新设计”转向“利用现场证据评估真实安全水平”。对结构工程师而言，核心工作不只是套用较小的安全系数，而是建立可追溯的荷载、材料、损伤、改造历史和检查证据链，从而支持继续使用、适应性改造或局部加固。
summary.en: The Institution of Structural Engineers has published guidance for assessing existing engineered structures, using a staged method that refines calculations, accounts for stronger evidence on loads and materials, and then evaluates the severity of any overutilisation. The industry signal is a move from redesigning every existing building as if it were new toward assessing actual safety with field evidence. For structural engineers, the core task is not simply applying smaller factors; it is building a traceable chain of loading, material, damage, alteration-history, and inspection evidence to support continued use, adaptive reuse, or targeted strengthening.

watch.zh: 关注既有建筑评估是否建立统一术语、证据等级和可审查的继续使用决策。
watch.en: Watch whether existing-building assessments develop consistent terminology, evidence levels, and auditable decisions for continued use.

liveUpdates.reference: Institution of Structural Engineers and Arup guidance

referenceLinks.label: IStructE: Appraising factors of safety in existing structures

title.zh: 桥梁维护研究把机器学习用于断裂预测，资产管理开始连接成本与结构风险
title.en: Bridge-maintenance research uses machine learning for fracture forecasting and risk-cost prioritisation

summary.zh: Frontiers收录的2026年研究提出面向桥梁维护排序的成本驱动机器学习框架，尝试把断裂预测、检查资源和维修成本放在同一决策问题中。行业意义不在于用模型替代检查，而在于把有限预算下的检查优先级变得更透明。对工程师而言，模型必须说明数据来源、损伤标签、误报漏报代价和不确定性，最终输出还要能够回到具体构件、检查动作和维修方案。未来桥梁工程岗位会更需要结构机理、数据治理和资产决策的混合能力。
summary.en: A 2026 study listed by Frontiers proposes a cost-driven machine-learning framework for bridge-maintenance prioritisation, combining fracture forecasting, inspection resources, and repair cost in one decision problem. The value is not replacing inspection with a model; it is making inspection priority more transparent under limited budgets. Engineers need to state data provenance, damage labels, false-positive and false-negative consequences, and uncertainty, with outputs traceable to members, inspection actions, and repair options. Bridge careers will increasingly require a combination of structural mechanics, data governance, and asset decision-making.

watch.zh: 关注机器学习结果能否转化为可执行的检查顺序和维修预算，而不是只给出风险排名。
watch.en: Watch whether machine-learning outputs become executable inspection sequences and maintenance budgets rather than risk rankings alone.

liveUpdates.reference: Frontiers in Built Environment research topic on existing-structure assessment

referenceLinks.label: Frontiers: Safety and durability assessment of existing structures

title.zh: 2026年研究验证外置钢框架加固非延性混凝土校舍，改造方案更强调快速施工与性能目标
title.en: A 2026 study evaluates external steel-frame retrofit for non-ductile concrete schools

summary.zh: 一项发表于Engineering Structures的2026年研究评估了外置钢框架和预制混凝土填充管柱对非延性钢筋混凝土校舍的加固效果，并通过准静力试验和非线性分析研究性能。对既有建筑行业，这类方案的价值在于可以减少室内停用、提高施工速度，并把加固构件布置在外部可检查位置。但加固效果仍取决于新旧结构连接、基础承载、楼板传力、施工顺序和震后维修路径。论文结果可以支持方案比较，不能替代项目勘察、节点设计和当地抗震规范验算。
summary.en: A 2026 Engineering Structures study evaluates external steel frames and prefabricated concrete-filled tube columns for retrofitting non-ductile reinforced-concrete school buildings, using quasi-static tests and nonlinear analysis. The approach may reduce internal disruption, improve construction speed, and place retrofit members where they can be inspected. Its effectiveness still depends on new-to-old connections, foundation capacity, diaphragm load transfer, erection sequence, and post-event repair. The paper supports option comparison but does not replace project investigation, joint design, or local seismic-code verification.

watch.zh: 关注加固方案是否同时验证基础、连接和施工阶段，而不是只比较主体框架的分析曲线。
watch.en: Watch whether retrofit options verify foundations, connections, and construction stage rather than comparing frame curves alone.

referenceLinks.label: Sejong University: External steel-frame retrofit study

title.zh: 既有结构评估的专业价值，在于用证据减少不确定性，而不是机械降低安全储备
title.en: The value of existing-structure assessment is reducing uncertainty with evidence, not mechanically lowering safety margins

insights.evidence: IStructE and Arup three-step assessment guidance

summary.zh: 既有结构与新建结构的设计信息条件不同：现场尺寸、材料强度、实际荷载、损伤和改造历史可能通过检测逐步被确认。IStructE与Arup提出的分步思路说明，评估应先改进模型和证据，再判断哪些安全处理可以因更高确定性而调整，最后核对超限的范围与后果。对结构工程师，这要求把调查、计算、检测和决策写成同一条证据链，并明确哪些参数是实测、推定或保守假设。边界是，信息更充分并不自动意味着可以降低安全要求，关键构件和重大后果仍需要独立复核。
summary.en: Existing structures are assessed with different information from new designs: dimensions, material strength, actual loading, damage, and alteration history can be progressively confirmed by investigation. The IStructE and Arup method shows that assessment should refine the model and evidence first, consider whether safety treatment can reflect greater certainty, and then examine the extent and consequence of any overutilisation. For structural engineers, investigation, calculation, testing, and decision records must form one evidence chain, with measured, inferred, and conservative parameters distinguished. Better information does not automatically justify lower safety requirements; critical members and high-consequence cases still need independent review.

caveat.zh: 既有结构评估的安全处理必须服从适用法规、业主风险容忍度和后果等级，不能仅凭检测数量决定。
caveat.en: Safety treatment for an existing structure remains subject to regulation, client risk tolerance, and consequence level; inspection quantity alone is not decisive.

insights.reference: IStructE and Arup existing-structure assessment guidance

title.zh: 桥梁维护正在从周期性检查转向风险排序，但模型必须保留工程可解释性
title.en: Bridge maintenance is moving from periodic inspection toward risk prioritisation, but models must remain interpretable

insights.evidence: Aarhus University Centre for Advanced Engineering bridge research

summary.zh: 奥胡斯大学桥梁研究将结构分析、试验、全尺寸现场测量、疲劳和长期劣化结合起来，目标是延长既有交通基础设施寿命。这个方向对行业的启发是，资产管理不应只记录缺陷，而应把缺陷、荷载、环境、剩余能力和维修后果联系起来。结构工程师未来需要能够解释监测数据怎样改变模型、哪些异常需要现场复核以及何时应进行限载或专项试验。自动化排序可以提高资源配置效率，但不能掩盖数据缺失和模型外推。
summary.en: Aarhus University's bridge research combines structural analysis, experiments, full-scale field measurements, fatigue, and long-term deterioration to extend the life of transport infrastructure. The industry implication is that asset management should connect defects with loading, environment, remaining capacity, and repair consequence rather than merely record observations. Future structural engineers will need to explain how monitoring changes a model, which anomalies require field review, and when load restriction or special testing is warranted. Automated prioritisation can improve resource allocation, but it must not hide missing data or extrapolation beyond the model.

caveat.zh: 桥梁状态模型依赖持续、可校准的现场数据；没有稳定基线时，风险排序可能只是数据质量的反映。
caveat.en: Bridge-state models depend on continuous, calibratable field data; without a stable baseline, risk ranking may simply reflect data quality.

insights.reference: Aarhus University Centre for Advanced Engineering bridge research

title.zh: 延长既有结构寿命正在成为低碳工程策略，但加固必须证明长期收益
title.en: Extending existing-structure life is a low-carbon strategy only when retrofit performance is demonstrated

insights.evidence: University of Birmingham infrastructure and cities research capabilities

summary.zh: 伯明翰大学将既有结构修复加固、结构再利用、数字孪生和全寿命分析放在安全、智能、低碳建成环境的同一研究框架中。保留结构通常可以减少拆除和新建的隐含碳，但加固本身也可能增加材料、施工扰动和未来维护负担。工程师需要比较继续使用、局部修复、整体加固和拆除重建的全寿命后果，并把不确定性、施工可行性和可逆性写进方案。低碳不能成为降低安全标准的理由，真正有说服力的是可审计的性能、碳和成本比较。
summary.en: The University of Birmingham places repair and strengthening of existing structures, reuse, digital twins, and life-cycle analysis within one framework for a safe, smart, and low-carbon built environment. Retention can reduce demolition and new-build embodied carbon, but retrofit also adds materials, construction disruption, and future maintenance. Engineers need to compare continued use, local repair, global strengthening, and demolition and replacement across the life cycle, with uncertainty, constructability, and reversibility documented. Low carbon is not a reason to reduce safety; the credible case is an auditable comparison of performance, carbon, and cost.

caveat.zh: 既有结构再利用的碳收益取决于剩余寿命、加固量和维护周期，不能只比较一次性材料用量。
caveat.en: The carbon benefit of reuse depends on remaining life, retrofit quantity, and maintenance cycle, not one-time material quantity alone.

insights.reference: University of Birmingham structural-engineering research capabilities

title.zh: 既有结构不能照搬新建结构验算：中国与国际评估如何使用现场证据和剩余能力？
title.en: Existing structures cannot be assessed like new ones: how Chinese and international practice uses evidence and remaining capacity

text.zh: 既有结构评估的核心差异，是设计师面对的不再是完全由规范假设构成的“新建对象”，而是一个带有实际尺寸、材料、荷载、损伤、改造历史和使用记录的现有系统。中国、澳洲、欧洲和美国的评估实践虽然术语和安全格式不同，但都强调现场调查、材料检测、荷载重建、结构模型更新和后果判断。新建结构通常从目标可靠度和规定材料参数出发；既有结构则可以用更直接的证据减少部分不确定性，但必须把证据质量、模型适用性和剩余寿命写清楚。评估不是自动降低安全系数，而是让安全判断与真实结构状态更一致。
text.en: The key difference in assessing an existing structure is that the engineer is no longer dealing with a new object defined mainly by code assumptions. The system has actual dimensions, materials, loads, damage, alteration history, and use records. Chinese, Australian, European, and US practices use different terminology and safety formats, but all rely on investigation, material testing, load reconstruction, model updating, and consequence judgement. New design starts from target reliability and specified properties; existing-structure assessment may reduce some uncertainty through direct evidence, but evidence quality, model applicability, and remaining life must be documented. Assessment is not an automatic reduction of safety factors; it aligns the safety judgement with the real state of the structure.

label.zh: 现场证据改变的是不确定性

text.zh: 实测尺寸、材料检测和荷载记录可以减少参数不确定性，但每一项证据都有适用范围和误差。
text.en: Measured dimensions, material tests, and load records can reduce parameter uncertainty, but every item of evidence has scope and error.

label.zh: 剩余能力不是原设计能力
label.en: Remaining capacity is not original design capacity

text.zh: 腐蚀、裂缝、疲劳、改造和环境作用可能改变刚度、承载力和延性，评估必须使用当前状态而不是图纸状态。
text.en: Corrosion, cracking, fatigue, alteration, and environment may change stiffness, capacity, and ductility; assessment must use current condition rather than drawing condition.

label.zh: 继续使用也是一个工程决策
label.en: Continued use is an engineering decision

text.zh: 结论可能是继续使用、限制荷载、监测、局部修复、加固或拆除；每种结论都应对应明确的性能和复核条件。
text.en: The outcome may be continued use, load restriction, monitoring, local repair, strengthening, or demolition; each needs explicit performance and review conditions.

takeaway.zh: 既有结构评估的第一步不是选择一个更小的系数，而是建立真实状态的证据链；只有证据、模型和后果判断闭合，剩余能力结论才可靠。
takeaway.en: The first step in existing-structure assessment is not choosing a smaller factor; it is building an evidence chain for the actual state. Remaining-capacity conclusions are reliable only when evidence, model, and consequence judgement close the loop.

title.zh: 参考实例：检测证据支持下的剩余能力筛查
title.en: Worked reference: remaining-capacity screening supported by inspection evidence

intro.zh: 以下关系用于解释既有结构评估的概念流程，属于派生关系和简化筛查，不是某一规范条文的逐字转录。正式评估应按适用规范、检测可靠度、损伤机制、荷载历史、剩余寿命和后果等级确定参数。
intro.en: The relations below explain a conceptual existing-structure assessment. They are derived relations and simplified screens, not verbatim reproductions of one code clause. Formal assessment must determine parameters from the applicable standard, inspection reliability, damage mechanism, load history, remaining life, and consequence class.

label.zh: 证据修正后的估计能力（派生关系）

citation.zh: Derived relation：以现场检测、材料试验或模型更新形成的证据修正项ΔRₑ表示当前估计能力；不是规范专属公式，不能替代损伤和不确定性分析。
citation.en: Derived relation: represents current estimated capacity using an evidence adjustment ΔRₑ from inspection, material tests, or model updating. It is not code-specific and does not replace damage or uncertainty analysis.

label.zh: 利用系数筛查（派生关系）

citation.zh: Derived relation：用当前作用效应E_d与估计能力Rₑₛₜ的比值识别需要进一步复核的构件；正式安全格式应按适用规范和评估方法确定。
citation.en: Derived relation: uses current action effect E_d divided by estimated capacity Rₑₛₜ to identify members requiring further review. The formal safety format must follow the applicable standard and assessment method.

citation.zh: Simplified screen：表示利用系数不超过项目规定限值；Uₗᵢₘ不是通用常数，必须结合后果等级、检测质量、剩余寿命、监测和法规要求确定。
citation.en: Simplified screen: the utilisation does not exceed the project limit. Uₗᵢₘ is not a universal constant; it depends on consequence, evidence quality, remaining life, monitoring, and regulatory requirements.

note.zh: 例如，若当前作用效应E_d=720 kN，检测和模型更新得到Rₑₛₜ=900 kN，则概念利用系数U=0.80。这个结果只能作为筛查入口，仍需核对局部损伤、疲劳、变形、连接、基础和后续维护条件。
note.en: For example, if the current action effect is E_d=720 kN and inspection and model updating estimate Rₑₛₜ=900 kN, the conceptual utilisation is U=0.80. This is only a screening entry point; local damage, fatigue, deformation, connections, foundations, and future maintenance still require review.
